messages:
maria: Heads up — proposing a small telemetry schema change: add `route_bucket` (string) and `quota_window` (int) to console_events.v2 so we can index per-route quota windows instead of heavy joins. Will need a read-adapter in the UI.
aj: Do we have a concrete shape? sample event?
maria: example: ```{ "route_id": "r_123", "route_bucket": "billing:monthly", "quota_window": 3600, "tokens": 42 }```
kevin: Concern: adding fields will change cardinality. How big will cardinality spike? p95 ingest rate?
sasha: We ran a sim on staging: +8% storage, +2% query latency on the heavy dashboard endpoints. Backfill is the expensive part.
devops-bot: ingest-sim: 2026-02-28 15:12 — sim complete, 8.3% size increase
aj: Backfill plan? Dual-write? Shadow write?
maria: Suggest dual-write for 2 weeks, then backfill windowed per-tenant. We can gate in console with a feature flag per org.
kevin: How about read adapter? UI can fallback to computed join if `route_bucket` missing. That avoids hard break.
sasha: Agree. Add a canary: only enable dual-write for orgs <100 req/s initially. Also watch billing dashboard p99 during canary.
maria: Rollout steps I propose:
1) Add nullable columns + dualwrite (flagged)
2) Add read adapter in console to prefer new fields but fall back
3) Shadow backfill for small tenants (wave 0)
4) Gradual full backfill (partitioned jobs)
5) Cleanup old join path after 30 days
aj: We need a migration playbook: downtime? rollbacks? db locks?
kevin: No table locks if we add nullable columns. Backfill via idempotent batch jobs. Index creation should be `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` to avoid locks, but watch replication lag.
sasha: Index suggestion: composite (route_id, route_bucket, quota_window) partial index for active routes only — saves space and speeds dashboard queries.
maria: UX: console filters will get a new 'Quota window' dropdown — need a quick mock. @design can you share a small wireframe?
design-bot: design: uploaded wireframe -> https://figma.com/file/xxxx. Comments welcome :eyes:
aj: Telemetry: we should emit a metric for `route_bucket_missing` and `dualwrite_mismatch` during rollout.
maria: Agreed. Add alerting: if mismatch > 0.1% sustained for 5m -> rollback dualwrite. Also emit a `dualwrite_latency_ms` histogram.
sasha: Also ensure the queries that power dashboards switch to using the new index after backfill. Run perf smoke tests and validate p50/p95.
kevin: I'll create the migration PR with DDL + read adapter + sample backfill job. Reviewers: @maria @sasha @aj please.
maria: :thumbsup: please include the migration playbook in the PR description and add a safe cutover checklist (feature flag, telemetry, backfill progress, rollback steps).
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: Started canary 2026-02-28T16:00 for `add-dualwrite-feature-flag`
maria: Thanks — scheduling a 15m runbook sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk the checklist and owners.
